data.Name: Revenge of the Patrol
data.Description: Strike back against the enemy camp that captured your allies
data.Template_Text: [NPC1] leads you toward the enemy camp near [Location1]. The camp commander, [Enemy1], must be eliminated to avenge the fallen patrol. The rescued soldier fights at your side — time to even the score!
data.2nd_state_Template_Text: With [NPC1] at your side, you stormed the camp near [Location1] and brought down [Enemy1]. The fallen patrol has been avenged, and the area is safe once more. The soldier salutes you — a bond forged in battle.
